Gate fixtures refuse missing record, wrong head, wrong old/new hash, wrong attester/App, altered delta, unresolved finding, and a stand-in without promotion evidence; a valid exact-head record can pass only with an otherwise valid verdict.
Byte-identical rebase/new head requires a fresh promotion review; ordinary carry behaviour is unchanged.

description:
Land the new promotion-input behaviour in BenchBox's trusted base engine first, then port the accepted change into Theseus before final parity. A small lock diff is not the reviewed upstream delta: materialize trusted old/new source trees, classify using upstream delta statistics, force gate-tier/non-inline mode, and require read evidence for every changed reviewable upstream file in the staged workspace. Add the lock and installer paths to classifier.gate_paths. Reuse runner staging/evidence patterns, not a second reviewer architecture.
Gate enforcement: a head-bound promotion refusal sits alongside the omp-bump refusal and is evaluated before stand-ins. Its evidence record follows the owner's decision item and binds old/new source and artifact hashes, delta digest and exact PR head. Promotion reviews cannot carry across rebases, even with identical patch digests. Read only existing PR/comment/review/status inputs; no Actions read permission. Gate-path fork PRs remain fail-closed and require the existing owner workflow, never candidate credentials.
Guardrails: no bypass on absent evidence; no owner attestation invented by an agent; no unsigned/local claim becoming gate authority; no marker semantics change without versioned compatibility proof. Workflow changes need explicit owner approval where required. Preserve ordinary PR behaviour and current all-severity blockers. Scope is new behaviour, not a claimed mechanical extraction.
